root_cause.text: In `papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle()` the `FD_PREPARE()` conversion made `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)` invalidate the `src_info` pointer before it was later reused for `list_add()` on `hvpipe_src_list`, so the code dereferenced a NULL pointer while trying to insert the source record into the global list.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE says the bug appeared “after call to `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)`, `src_info` is re-used for adding it to the global list,” and the patch fixes it by moving allocation/list insertion before `FD_ADD()` and removing the old `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)`/`FD_PREPARE()` flow that led to the NULL dereference.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove the one-process-per-source rejection check so handle creation can proceed without blocking on an existing source user.
intent_record.what: In papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle(), the automatic cleanup annotation and initialization on src_info were removed, a new local int fd was added, and the entire spinlock-protected lookup/duplicate-source check using hvpipe_find_source() along with its -EALREADY return path was deleted before the kzalloc_obj() allocation.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function no longer rejects creation when the source is already in use by another process, so duplicate handle creation for the same srcID is no longer prevented by this code path; it now proceeds directly to allocate a new hvpipe_source_info structure, changing the previous exclusivity enforcement behavior.

intent_record.intent_summary: Make hvpipe handle creation enforce single-process source ownership and clean up correctly when FD allocation fails.
intent_record.what: The function `papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle(u32 srcID)` was rewritten to remove the `FD_PREPARE`/`fd_publish` flow and instead use `FD_ADD` with `anon_inode_getfile(...)` directly. The code now acquires `hvpipe_src_list_lock` before checking for an existing source, returns `-EALREADY` after logging an error and freeing `src_info` if the source already exists, adds `src_info` to the global list before creating the FD, and on FD creation failure removes the entry from the list, conditionally calls `hvpipe_rtas_recv_msg(NULL, 0)` if a message is pending, frees `src_info`, and returns the error code.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this change makes source registration exclusive earlier and more explicitly prevents multiple processes from using the same source ID. It also changes failure handling so that if file descriptor creation fails after the source has been registered, the source is rolled back from the global list and any pending message is consumed to avoid leaving the hvpipe blocked. This reduces resource leaks and stale state when handle creation fails.

grouping_result.intent: Remove the one-process-per-source rejection check so handle creation can proceed without blocking on an existing source user.
Make hvpipe handle creation enforce single-process source ownership and clean up correctly when FD allocation fails.

relevance_review.reason: The change only removes a one-process-per-source rejection check. It does not address the NULL pointer dereference caused by reusing src_info after retain_and_null_ptr(src_info) in list_add(), so it is unrelated to the root cause.

The group targets hvpipe handle creation and cleanup in the same function implicated by the root cause. Since the bug is about `papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle()` reusing a pointer after `FD_PREPARE()`/`retain_and_null_ptr()` nulls it, a fix to handle creation and failure cleanup is directly related to that vulnerable code path.

candidates.rationale: This conversion nulls out src_info after ownership transfer, but the same pointer is later reused. That makes the subsequent list insertion operate on an invalidated pointer, which is the direct cause of the NULL dereference described in the root cause.

This is the statement that dereferences src_info after it has been invalidated by retain_and_null_ptr(src_info). The crash occurs here when the code tries to add the source record to the global list using a NULL pointer.

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable construct described in the root cause is not present in this snippet. In `papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle()`, the code allocates `src_info`, then later does `list_add(&src_info->list, &hvpipe_src_list);` while `src_info` is still the live pointer. There is no `FD_PREPARE()` call, no `retain_and_null_ptr(src_info)` conversion, and no reuse of a nulled `src_info` for `list_add()`. The relevant lines are: `src_info = kzalloc(...);`, `file = anon_inode_getfile(... (void *)src_info, ...)`, and `list_add(&src_info->list, &hvpipe_src_list);`. Since the NULL-dereference-inducing pattern is absent, `has_bug` is false. Because the fix for that specific bug is likewise not shown as already needed here, `is_fixed` is false.
